name: ETH clásica
author: Loeb (Galileo Project), Mack (parcial)
one_sentence_es: Son alienígenas de otros planetas con tecnología avanzada.
one_sentence_en: They are aliens from other planets with advanced technology.

name: Sistema de control
author: Jacques Vallée (1975)
one_sentence_es: Es un sistema que regula nuestra creencia colectiva, no objetos físicos.
one_sentence_en: It's a system that regulates our collective belief, not physical objects.

name: Entidades depredadoras
author: Salvador Freixedo (1984), John Keel
one_sentence_es: Son entidades hostiles que se alimentan de nuestra energía emocional y se disfrazan de dioses.
one_sentence_en: They are hostile entities that feed on our emotional energy and disguise themselves as gods.

name: Contacto psicoespiritual
author: John E. Mack (Harvard), Whitley Strieber
one_sentence_es: Es contacto transformacional con una inteligencia 'Other' que excede nuestras categorías.
one_sentence_en: It is transformational contact with an 'Other' intelligence beyond our categories.

name: Multidimensional
author: Hal Puthoff, Eric Davis, AAWSAP
one_sentence_es: Vienen de otras dimensiones físicas, no de otros planetas.
one_sentence_en: They come from other physical dimensions, not other planets.

name: Civilización paralela (breakaway)
author: Jorjani, Lazar (claims)
one_sentence_es: Es tecnología de una civilización humana secreta paralela.
one_sentence_en: It's technology from a secret parallel human civilization.

name: Viajeros del tiempo
author: Masters, Jorjani (taxonomy)
one_sentence_es: Son descendientes humanos del futuro investigando su pasado.
one_sentence_en: They are human descendants from the future investigating their past.

name: Criptoterrestre / atlante
author: Tim Lomas (2024), Jorjani
one_sentence_es: Son una civilización terrestre prehistórica que sobrevive oculta.
one_sentence_en: They are a prehistoric terrestrial civilization that survives hidden.

name: Avatar de simulación
author: Jorjani (taxonomy)
one_sentence_es: UAPs son interfaces de una realidad simulada.
one_sentence_en: UAPs are interfaces of a simulated reality.

name: Marco de subyugación política
author: Jason Reza Jorjani (2021)
origin: Operación de control — estados terrestres + threat externa fabricada
one_sentence_es: El disclosure controlado prepara gobierno global totalitario justificado por amenaza exterior.
one_sentence_en: Controlled disclosure prepares totalitarian global governance justified by external threat.

name: Pluralidad (posición del corpus)
author: Corpus
one_sentence_es: No es UN solo fenómeno — son varios fenómenos distintos mezclados.
one_sentence_en: It's not ONE phenomenon — it's several distinct phenomena mixed together.
